node.statement: Still under that extra hypothesis, substitute the inverse identity into the contour definition theta(U)=(2 pi i)^{-1} integral_Gamma theta(lambda)(lambda 1-U)^{-1} d lambda. Linearity of iota_n gives theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This proves only the conditional statement; the registered def-compressed-corner supplies no premise identifying its theta with this construction, so node 1.4 and hence the root remain unsupported without an additional allowed definition or external theorem.
